notes.title: Vaporwave Pinball update & Bundle with AXYZ
notes.content:
[p][b]A NEW PHYSICS SYSTEM[/b][/p][p]Vaporwave Pinball's latest update has gone live and whilst many small fixes to bugs have gone in, the main news about it is that I have revamped the physics so you now have more control. This actually makes the game much easier, especially when precision aiming with the ball on the flippers.

I also added some magical code to reduce the "unfair" ways the ball would just fall down without the player being able to do anything - now, this wont eliminate that, after all, luck is a big part of pinball but it has limited it a LOT. You might notice it now but your brain will.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]A NEW BUNDLE[/b][/p][p]As part of an upcoming sale, Space lion studios and myself are teaming up to offer a AXYZ X Vaporwave pinball bundle, which offers a whopping 25% off.

The games were in development in unison and I am great friends with the developers behind AXYZ. I even did a tiny amount of work on it, so its great to twin these games up.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44242494/6fb6c7f471804bf0589079efb4fb41af04b1f664.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]About Axyz[/b][/i]
[i]"Axyz is a retro gravity switching puzzle game that asks the player to use their environmental and spatial awareness to beat every level. Soak in the vaporwave, switch gravity, collect tapes, and more in this tribute to 90s puzzle games."[/i][/p][p][i]


[/i]You can find the bundle in the link below. Grab it and don't forget to leave a review!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55880/Axyz__Vaporwave_Pinball/"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fun things that have happened!
notes.content:
Its been a couple of weeks since Vaporwave Pinball dropped onto Steam and Im happy to say that the response has been largely positive!

Some bugs have slipped through and I am working on a patch to fix all those things, so keep an eye out for that.



Here are some things that I think were cool:


[h3]Vaporwave Pinball was selected to be a part of the London gaming festivals "official selection"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44242494/1f976270df950f99f4ce47071da26524f390da9d.jpg[/img]
I got to showcase the game at new game plus, a new event in London and it was a blast. I was at this event when I launched the game which was stressful but also kind of fun?
I met some cool people and its always great seeing people enjoy your game!


[h3]People are sending me pictures of themselves playing Vaporwave pinball[/h3]
As mentioned before, It is always cool seeing people play your game. It's weird seeing it in other peoples houses but it is neat. especially when the game is lighting up a dark room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44242494/05e4308cfd96eee7c21a167b69579bef9e0d6fd0.jpg[/img]
Sent by [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kinix17.bsky.social]kinix17[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44242494/31b7aa66e1fd85f8d43e39662aff90ca6d123e86.jpg[/img]
Sent by [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kanaratron.bsky.social/post/3lm2i5rvrw223]kanaratron[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44242494/4a51b353d99bdd8ee0395b896267c1f9afbae3b7.jpg[/img]
Sent by ‪[url=https://bsky.app/profile/bortmedia.bsky.social]bortmedia[/url]


[h3]I got a few mentions on some cool youtube channels[/h3]
VWPB has been covered more than I was expecting but one of my favorite things was being interviewed by Gaming in the wild, a channel I happen to like anyway.

[url=https://youtu.be/KlOToCQa5hk?t=1183]Gaming in the wild interview[/url]





That is all for this update but expect a patch list soon!



(not bought the game yet? get it here!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465930/Vaporwave_Pinball/

notes.title: Post launch Hot Fix 001
notes.content:
V1.01 is live.
Fixes include:


[list]
[*] Added version number to title screen
[*] Ball bounces less on flippers, making for a smoother experience.
[*] Table 01's ball start position has been changed, meaning it won't fall straight into the fail zone as often.
[*] Score should reset between Tables
[*] debug way to reset the game by holding down flippers for several seconds has been removed.
[/list]

Want to report a bug? 
Head here:
[url=Bug thread on Steam forums]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2465930/discussions/0/595144973737857795/[/url]

or join our Discord
[url=https://discord.com/invite/yJr3z7D]https://discord.com/invite/yJr3z7D[/url]


Cheers!

Jamie D
